answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities with a sunk, non-refundable fee per identity. To join, an agent pays 20 credits, a walnut's price, burned at registration and checked before trading. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards. An attacker making 1,000 fakes must burn 20,000 credits, yet each fake earns at most 5 before detection, losing 15,000. Without the tax, fakes spiral unchecked and trust falls to its nadir; forgery does not pay.
